definitions.explanation: Education focused on physical fitness and sports skills; also refers to athletics and physical exercise in general.

{体育|たいいく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。

notes:
{体育|たいいく} refers to physical education as a school subject and to physical fitness/athletics more broadly. The reading is たいいく (four morae), though it is often pronounced たいく in casual speech.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{体育館|たいいくかん}→体育館：03111_taiikukan⟧: gymnasium
- ⟦{体育祭|たいいくさい}→体育祭：21233_taiikusai⟧: sports festival (school event)
- {体育|たいいく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: Sports Day (national holiday, October)
- {体育|たいいく}⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧: physical education university

SCHOOL CONTEXT:
- {体育|たいいく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧: PE class
- {体育|たいいく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧: PE teacher
- ⟦{体育着|たいいくぎ}→体育着：noentry⟧: PE uniform/gym clothes

CULTURAL NOTE:
{体育|たいいく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Sports Day) is a national holiday established to commemorate the 1964 Tokyo Olympics.
